tema: Wish & If Only — Regrets and Desires

cast_dialogue.linea: 'Wish' and 'if only' are the grammar of the heart, heroes: past simple for present desires, past perfect for regrets, 'would' for complaints.
I wish I had brought an umbrella. If only I had checked the weather this morning!
I wish I could speak French — my restaurant has French customers every week.
I wish I lived closer to the centre. And I wish my neighbours would stop making noise!
I wish I were twenty again, mis héroes. But if only we appreciated today more — yesterday's wishes become tomorrow's regrets.

banco_oraciones.oracion: I wish I lived closer to the centre. (present desire)
I wish I had brought an umbrella. (past regret)
I wish I could speak French. (ability)
If only I were twenty again.
I wish I didn't waste so much time.
If only I hadn't sold my bike.
Do you wish you lived somewhere else?
What do you wish you had studied?
Don't you wish you could fly?
Do you wish you were on holiday? Yes, I do.
Do you regret it? Yes, if only I had known.
Do you wish you played an instrument? Yes, I wish I did.

banner_diagnostico.opcion_a: I wish I would live closer to the centre.
banner_diagnostico.opcion_b: I wish I lived closer to the centre.

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Wish/if only + past simple = desire about the present ('I wish I lived closer'). Wish/if only + past perfect = regret about the past ('If only I had studied'). Wish + would = complaint about annoying behaviour ('I wish you would listen'). 'If only' is stronger and more dramatic than 'I wish'.

filas: I wish I had studied harder.
I wish they would be quiet.

ejercicios.pregunta: I wish I ___ closer to the centre. (now)
If only I ___ an umbrella. (this morning)
I wish my neighbours ___ making noise. (complaint)

ejercicios.afirmacion: For regrets about the past we use 'wish + past perfect'.
'I wish I would be taller' is correct.

ejercicios.texto: If only I ___ (not sell) my bike.

ejercicios.respuesta: I wish I were twenty again.

ejercicios.texto_con_error: I wish I would live closer to the centre.
ejercicios.respuesta: I wish I lived closer to the centre.

ejercicios.oracion_base: I regret not studying harder at school.
ejercicios.respuesta: If only I had studied harder at school.

ejercicios.oracion_base: I want to live closer. (unreal now)

ejercicios.pregunta: Write three wishes: one present desire, one past regret and one complaint.
ejercicios.respuesta: I wish I had more free time. If only I had learned the piano. I wish my phone would stop ringing.

guion: Ben: I wish I had brought an umbrella. If only I had checked the weather!
Sofía: Poor thing. I wish I lived closer — you could have run to my place.
Ben: And I wish this bus would come! We've been waiting for ages.
Sofía: Any other wishes while we're here?
Ben: Yes — I wish I were on a beach right now.
Sofía: Careful, Ben. Abuela Carmen says yesterday's wishes become tomorrow's regrets. Enjoy the rain!

reading.texto: Ben stood in the rain and sighed: 'I wish I had brought an umbrella. If only I had checked the weather!' Sofía wished she lived closer to the city centre, and Kenji wished he could speak French — his restaurant had French customers every week. Abuela Carmen smiled wisely: 'I wish I were twenty again, mis héroes. But if only we appreciated today more — yesterday's wishes become tomorrow's regrets.'

preguntas.afirmacion: Kenji wishes he could speak French.

partes.parte: B — Reescribe con wish / if only

ejercicios.texto: I regret not studying harder at school. → (If only)
I want to live closer, but I don't. → (I wish)
My brother never calls me, and it annoys me. → (I wish + would)
Corrige: 'I wish I would live closer to the centre.'
Corrige: 'If only I would have brought an umbrella.'
Escribe 4 deseos: 1 presente, 1 pasado, 1 queja y 1 con 'could'.
